import numpy as np, sys
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dA_dt; var=np.var(y)
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
models={
'prev_t':lambda p: -(p[0]*A**p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*A)*np.exp(-p[3]*t) + p[4]*A/(1+p[5]*A**2)*np.exp(-p[6]*t) + p[7]/t + p[8]*np.exp(-p[9]*A)*t),
'expAt':lambda p: -(p[0]*A**p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*A*t)*np.exp(-p[3]*t) + p[4]*A/(1+p[5]*A**2)*np.exp(-p[6]*t) + p[7]/t + p[8]*np.exp(-p[9]*A)),
}
for name,f in models.items():
    best=np.inf;bp=None
    for s in range(12):
        p0=rng.normal(0,0.5,10)
        p0[1]=abs(p0[1])+0.5; p0[5]=abs(p0[5])
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-y,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3), p0, max_nfev=150)
            nm=np.mean(r.fun**2)/var
            if nm<best: best=nm;bp=r.x
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(name, best, np.round(bp,3), flush=True)
